turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste ji, main fraud dispute team se bol raha hoon, aapka account check karne ke liye call kiya hai.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Arre yaar, mujhe laga koi galat transaction hua hai, shayad credit card Easy se paise cut gaye hain.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Haanji, hum aapke liye CIBIL Flex report check karwa ke, NirBharosa se bhi verify kar lenge.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Theek hai, lekin main chahunga ki aap ZepSahukar aur TavDaam dono ko ek saath freeze kar dein, kyunki Aadhaar Reserve ka bhi kuch doubt hai.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Ji bilkul, hum UPI Classic par fraud hold laga ke MorRokad ke through dispute file kar dete hain.
